pages.text: On an arm or leg: stops any bleeding below it, even arterial.
Esmarch rubber tourniquet: the same, may snap ($(cfg)15%$()).

A tourniquet is safe for $(cfg)15$() min of online time. Then the limb suffers ischemia ($(cfg)2$() per minute) and later $(l)necrosis$() — it will have to be amputated.$(br2)A tourniquet is temporary: dress, suture, remove it (empty hand in the $(l)H$() panel).
